name: Assistant self-evaluation of the three-round workflow
scope: Exploratory, unblinded self-evaluation in one Codex conversation. Not Symphonia's provider model and not an independent multi-model study.
inputs: The three saved authored platform scenarios and their final feedback-arm records; 4 claims and 8 fictional identities per scenario.
panel_size_rule: Larger panels tile the existing eight records 4x or 8x under new synthetic IDs. This tests input volume, not new independent experts or evidence.

scoring.strict_fidelity: Present, meaning, conditions, panel status and evidential status must all be correct. Self-assessed with output evidence spans; not independent semantic validation.
scoring.consensus: 80% directional support among all valid evaluations, including unable-to-judge; at least 80% response coverage. Narrative false consensus coded separately.
scoring.distribution: Base-2 Jensen-Shannon divergence between explicit reported and reference counts. Omitted/unassessable claims have penalty 1 in a separately labelled composite score.
scoring.uncertainty: Directly authored factual probability elicitation supplement, not confidence conversion. Mean individual binary entropy versus entropy of mean minus mean entropy. Normative claim excluded.
scoring.decision: Assistant chooses only from supplied options under an explicit constructed objective; loss minus minimum loss gives regret. Same-context, unblinded reader; no independent readers.
scoring.inference: No hypothesis tests or population confidence intervals: only three hand-authored scenarios in one context. No fabricated repetitions, model-family replication, or errors.

cost: Zero OpenRouter calls. Report recorded OpenRouter cost as zero; Codex account consumption and token cost are not measured.
stage_test: Extraction, round-two feedback and final synthesis evaluated on the baseline eight-person scenario. Downstream stages receive saved round-specific ratings, not newly generated independent participants.
deliverables: Five multi-panel figures, per-run full inputs/output/audit/decision, source CSV/JSON, vector SVG/PDF and 600 dpi PNG; existing consultations remain unchanged.
